d: Kylian Mbappe's controversial remarks about China have landed Real Madrid and La Liga in an uncomfortable position. What started as a joke has turned into a major controversy, with backlash in China, an apology from the Real Madrid forward and questions over the club's commercial relationship with one of football's biggest markets. With La Liga president Javier Tebas attempting to manage the fallout, Jose Mourinho has also weighed in, advising Mbappe to be careful about what he says. But in an era where footballers are global brands, how much freedom do the biggest stars really have to…
